ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "SELECT Id, OpportunityNumber__c, Name, StageName, Type, CloseDate, Description, " ++ "Is_Test_Account_Opportunity__c, Project_Requirement_Met__c, ProductionInstanceName__c, " ++ "NeonCRM_Modules__c, ProductRollup__c, Includes_Web_Template_Copy__c, BusinessUnit__c, " ++ "JIRA_SETUP_Issue__c, JIRA_SETUP_Status__c, JIRA_SETUP_Status_Updated__c, JIRA_Error_Message__c, " // Scenario 2 (cancellation): the churn trigger fields and the per-product-line write-back fields ++ "Risk_Stage__c, Forecast_Opportunity__c, " ++ "Neon_CRM_Cancellation_JIRA__c, Neon_CRM_Cancellation_Error__c, " ++ "Fundraise_Cancellation_JIRA__c, Fundraise_Cancellation_Error__c, " ++ "Arts_People_Cancellation_JIRA__c, Arts_People_Cancellation_Error__c, " ++ "AccountId, Account.Name, Account.Neon_CRM_Instance_Created_Date__c, Account.NCRM_Instance__c, " // Scenario 2: the Account carries one instance identifier per product line, plus the cancellation outcome set by Apex ++ "Account.RB_RB_ID__c, Account.Arts_People_Theatre_Id__c, Account.Deactivation_Date__c, Account.CancellationStatus__c, Account.IsTestAccount__c, " ++ "PrimaryContact__c, PrimaryContact__r.Name, PrimaryContact__r.Email, " ++ "TechnicalContact__c, TechnicalContact__r.Name, TechnicalContact__r.Email, " ++ "OwnerId, Owner.Name, Owner.Email, SalesRep__c, SalesRep__r.Name, SalesRep__r.Email" ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.extraFields)) "" else ", " ++ (vars.extraFields joinBy ", ")) ++ " FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = ':id'"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var r = vars.rows[0] fun person(id, rel) = if (id == null and rel == null) null else { id: id, name: rel.Name, email: rel.Email } // Arts People theatre id is a Number in Salesforce (arrives as 1376.0); the ticket needs "1376" fun wholeNumberText(v) = if (v == null) null else (floor(v as Number) as String) fun blankAsNull(v) = if (v == null or isEmpty(trim(v as String))) null else v // Salesforce Date fields: the connector may hand them over as a String, a Date or a DateTime; the contract is always yyyy-MM-dd fun dateOnly(v) = if (v == null) null else ((v as Date) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd" }) --- { id: r.Id, opportunityNumber: r.OpportunityNumber__c, name: r.Name, stageName: r.StageName, "type": r.Type, closeDate: dateOnly(r.CloseDate), description: r.Description, isTestAccountOpportunity: r.Is_Test_Account_Opportunity__c, projectRequirementMet: r.Project_Requirement_Met__c, productionInstanceName: r.ProductionInstanceName__c, neonCrmModules: r.NeonCRM_Modules__c, productRollup: r.ProductRollup__c, includesWebTemplateCopy: r.Includes_Web_Template_Copy__c, businessUnit: r.BusinessUnit__c, jiraSetupIssueKey: r.JIRA_SETUP_Issue__c, jiraSetupStatus: r.JIRA_SETUP_Status__c, jiraSetupStatusUpdated: r.JIRA_SETUP_Status_Updated__c, jiraErrorMessage: r.JIRA_Error_Message__c, riskStage: r.Risk_Stage__c, forecastOpportunity: r.Forecast_Opportunity__c, account: { id: r.AccountId, name: r.Account.Name, neonCrmInstanceCreatedDate: dateOnly(r.Account.Neon_CRM_Instance_Created_Date__c), ncrmInstance: blankAsNull(r.Account.NCRM_Instance__c), rbId: blankAsNull(r.Account.RB_RB_ID__c), artsPeopleTheatreId: wholeNumberText(r.Account.Arts_People_Theatre_Id__c), deactivationDate: dateOnly(r.Account.Deactivation_Date__c), cancellationStatus: r.Account.CancellationStatus__c, isTestAccount: r.Account.IsTestAccount__c }, // Scenario 2 write-back fields, one pair per product line (set by the registry Flow, never by Mule) deactivation: { neonCrm: { jiraKey: blankAsNull(r.Neon_CRM_Cancellation_JIRA__c), error: r.Neon_CRM_Cancellation_Error__c }, neonFundraise: { jiraKey: blankAsNull(r.Fundraise_Cancellation_JIRA__c), error: r.Fundraise_Cancellation_Error__c }, artsPeople: { jiraKey: blankAsNull(r.Arts_People_Cancellation_JIRA__c), error: r.Arts_People_Cancellation_Error__c } }, primaryContact: person(r.PrimaryContact__c, r.PrimaryContact__r), technicalContact: person(r.TechnicalContact__c, r.TechnicalContact__r), owner: person(r.OwnerId, r.Owner), salesRep: person(r.SalesRep__c, r.SalesRep__r), extra: if (isEmpty(vars.extraFields)) null else vars.extraFields reduce ((f, acc = {}) -> acc ++ { (f): r[f] }) }
